html:
As the State of Delaware has recently provided new guidance on shelter-in-place and non-essential business closures, we would like to provide an update on our status in support of our valued customers.

Accudyne will remain open during the Delaware non-essential business shutdown.

Please refer to the attached file for more information.

COVID-19-Accudyne-Status-20200323Download

Our business is a critical part of the economy in Delaware as a manufacturer and seller of industrial equipment serving multiple industries across the world.  This is a responsibility we take very seriously along with the health and wellbeing of our workforce and their families.
